notes: Cloud sync starts within minutes of being switched on, and right after you sign in. Before, a copy that checked while it was still off waited a day.
A downloaded update now shows as a card in the bottom-right corner, with Restart now. Cardwright checks for updates every 30 minutes, and when you come back to it.
Cloud sync also runs when you come back to Cardwright, as well as every 15 minutes and after each save.
Settings, License: I have one: sign in is clearer, and offers to make the account if you don't have one yet.
